descriptions.button: Variants, sizes, loading and disabled states.
descriptions.formControls: Plain text fields with invalid and disabled states.
descriptions.select: Pick one value from a short list.
descriptions.combobox: Type to filter a long list. Arrow keys move, Enter chooses.
descriptions.datePicker: A calendar that follows the language and direction.
descriptions.phoneInput: Country code and number; the value is always in international (E.164) format.
descriptions.currencyInput: Stores whole minor units (cents, paise, fils), never decimals.
descriptions.badge: Small labels for counts and tags.
descriptions.statusBadge: Every case stage and exit stage, coloured by group.
descriptions.card: A container with header, content and footer.
descriptions.tabs: Switch between related views. Arrow keys move between tabs.
descriptions.dialog: A modal window that traps focus until closed.
descriptions.sheet: A side panel that opens on the reading-end edge.
descriptions.drawer: A bottom drawer you can drag down to dismiss, made for phones.
descriptions.toast: Short messages that appear and fade away.
descriptions.tooltip: A hint shown on hover and on keyboard focus.
descriptions.dropdownMenu: A menu of actions for one item.
descriptions.avatar: Initials are shown when there is no photo.
descriptions.emptyState: Shown when a list has nothing to display yet.
descriptions.errorState: Shown when loading failed, with a retry action.
descriptions.pageHeader: Title, description, breadcrumbs and actions. Actions wrap below the title on phones.
descriptions.breadcrumbs: Where you are in the app. The separator flips in right-to-left.
descriptions.confirmDialog: Asks before an irreversible action and shows progress while it runs.
descriptions.dataTable: Server-side search, sorting and paging, column visibility, row selection and CSV export. The second table renders only the rows in view.
descriptions.formFields: Fields connected to React Hook Form and Zod, with labels, hints and errors wired for screen readers.
descriptions.fileUploader: Multipart upload to S3 with progress and retry, up to 500 MB per file. This demo uploads to a mock endpoint; try "flaky.pdf" to see a retry.
descriptions.stageTracker: The twelve case stages. Vertical on phones, horizontal from tablet width.
descriptions.timeline: A history of events, in order.
descriptions.chatPanel: Message list and composer. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.
descriptions.statCard: Key numbers with a trend. Loading shows a placeholder.
descriptions.kanbanBoard: Drag cards between columns with a mouse, a finger or the keyboard.
descriptions.appShell: The signed-in frame: a collapsible sidebar, a top bar and the page. On a phone the menu opens as a panel.
descriptions.switcher: A compact menu for choosing one value, such as the language or the currency.
descriptions.userMenu: The account button in the top bar, with the name, the role and actions such as signing out.
descriptions.notificationsMenu: The bell with an unread count, and a panel listing the latest notifications.
descriptions.brandMark: The logo, at any size. It is decorative: the name sits next to it as text.
descriptions.siteHeader: The public website header: logo, menu, language switcher and a call to action. On a phone the menu opens as a panel.
descriptions.siteFooter: Link columns, legal links and the copyright line.
descriptions.whatsappButton: The chat button. On the website it floats in the corner of the screen.
descriptions.documentList: A person's files with type tag, size, date, scan state and who can see them. A file that is still being scanned or did not pass cannot be opened.
descriptions.shareToggleList: One switch per hospital: turning it on is the patient's consent to share the document with that hospital.
descriptions.price: A price in the viewer’s language and currency: symbol and digits per locale, Latin digits in Arabic, figure kept left-to-right. A converted price shows ≈ and the original beneath.
descriptions.impersonationBanner: Shown across the top while a super admin is viewing the product as someone else. It cannot be dismissed; the only way out is to stop.

ops.overview: Your day at a glance: leads, tasks and cases that need attention.
ops.leads: Every lead from the website, WhatsApp, calls, agents and email, with source and duplicate detection.
ops.assignment: Round-robin or rule-based assignment by language, country and speciality, with SLA timers.
ops.pipeline: Kanban and list views by stage, filtered by country, treatment, hospital, owner and agent.
ops.cases: Open a case to see the patient, documents, notes, timeline, messages, quotes, payments, logistics and tasks.
ops.medical-summary: The reviewer form: diagnosis, key findings, recommended specialities and urgency.
ops.hospital-requests: Pick hospitals and doctors, attach the summary and reports, and track responses and due times.
ops.quotes: Combine hospital estimates with our package, apply currency and margin rules, and issue a branded quote.
ops.visa: Per traveller: documents received, invitation letter, application ID, status and decision date.
ops.tasks: Tasks per case and per user, created automatically when a case changes stage.
ops.messages: WhatsApp, email, SMS and in-app chat inside the case, with templates in each language.
ops.calls: Click-to-call through cloud telephony, with recordings attached to the case.
ops.templates: Quote, welcome pack, visa checklist and pre-travel checklist per country and language.
ops.logistics: Daily view of arrivals, departures, pickups, stays and interpreter bookings by city.
ops.ground: Today's jobs, pickup done with a photo, daily patient update and expenses.
ops.updates: Daily status notes for the family and alerts when the bill is over the estimate by more than 10%.
ops.incidents: Record complaints, medical complications and lost documents, with escalation to a manager.
ops.lost-reasons: The mandatory reasons for marking a case lost, which feed the reports.

hospital.overview: New requests, countdowns and admissions at a glance.
hospital.requests: New opinion requests with the case summary and reports, a due-time countdown, and accept or decline.
hospital.opinions: Treatment plan, assigned doctor, stay, package price, inclusions and exclusions, and validity date.
hospital.invitations: Upload the invitation letter from the government visa portal and mark it issued.
hospital.admissions: Admitted, surgery date, ICU or ward, expected discharge, final bill and discharge summary.
hospital.doctor: Read the case, write an opinion and set teleconsult slots.
hospital.teleconsult: Calendar slots, video calls and consult notes saved to the patient record.
hospital.onboarding: Hospital profile, accreditations with expiry, departments, doctors, rooms and tariffs, bank details and agreement.
hospital.packages: Fixed-price packages per procedure and room category, used by the cost estimator and quote builder.
hospital.branches: Group hospitals manage every branch from one login.
hospital.statements: Monthly list of referred patients, bills and the referral fee due, with a dispute flag.
hospital.performance: Response time, conversion rate and patient ratings.
hospital.api: For large groups: push and pull cases through an API instead of using the portal.

agent.overview: Your referrals, earnings and pending payouts at a glance.
agent.registration: Apply with ID and business proof, wait for KYC review and e-sign the agreement.
agent.refer: A quick form with report upload, or share your personal referral link or QR code.
agent.referrals: Referred cases and their stage, with no medical details beyond what the patient allows.
agent.commission: The commission rule per hospital and treatment; earned, approved, paid and pending amounts.
agent.payouts: Request a payout by international wire or local transfer, and see your payout history.
agent.marketing: Brochures, price sheets, videos and social posts in your language with your referral link.
agent.sub-agents: An agency adds its own staff as sub-users.
agent.leaderboard: Silver, Gold and Platinum tiers with higher commission by volume.
agent.training: Short lessons on visa rules, treatments and ethics, and the code of conduct to accept.

admin.overview: Key figures and items waiting for approval.
admin.users: Create staff users, assign roles and cities, deactivate, and force two-factor sign-in.
admin.masters: Countries, languages, currencies, treatments, specialities, cities, document types and lost reasons.
admin.hospital-approvals: Review onboarding, verify accreditation, and publish or unpublish profiles.
admin.agent-approvals: KYC review, commission plan assignment and suspension.
admin.cms: Edit treatment, hospital, doctor, city and blog pages with translations, SEO fields and a publish workflow.
admin.pricing: Service package prices, margins and currency conversion rates updated daily.
admin.templates: Email, WhatsApp, SMS and PDF templates in every language.
admin.reports: Success metrics with export to Excel.
admin.invoicing: GST-compliant invoices for service fees, and credit notes.
admin.payments: Card, international wire and UPI, payment links, partial payments and multi-currency with INR settlement.
admin.refunds: Request, approve and process refunds with a reason and a refund-policy check.
admin.referral-fees: Calculated from the final bill and agreement percentage, invoiced to the hospital, with ageing.
admin.commissions: Calculated when the hospital fee is received, with an approval step, payout batch file and TDS.
admin.deposits: Deposits paid through us on behalf of the hospital, tracked as a pass-through liability.
admin.vendor-payables: Stays, drivers, interpreters and SIM vendors.
admin.accounting-export: Sync to Tally or Zoho Books.
admin.profit: Revenue minus cost, per case, country, hospital and agent.
admin.stays: Guest houses, hotels and apartments with distance to each hospital, room types, rates and availability.
admin.transport: Vendors, drivers, vehicles including wheelchair and ambulance, city rates and job assignment.
admin.interpreters: Languages, city, rates, availability, assignment and hours log.
admin.welcome-kit: SIM cards, currency and kit items in stock per city.
admin.flights: Bookings made through the travel partner, with PNR and times, creating the pickup job automatically.
admin.audit: Who viewed or changed any patient record, with time and IP address.
admin.notifications: Every message the platform sent, on which channel, and whether it arrived. Send a test to check a channel.
